name: VolunteerProjectThumb - Linked Bare And Placeholder
description: All three thumbnail branches at real card width: a photo linked to its detail page, a photo with no link, and the gradient placeholder for a project with no photo yet. Shown side by side because the property that matters is that all three are the SAME HEIGHT — that is what keeps a grid mixing photo and no-photo projects aligned, and it is invisible in any single-branch shot.
